verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the GitHub mention of 'automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback fetch function'. That suggests automatic escalation through fallbacks when a fetch fails. Adaptive crawling, which stops once enough information is gathered, trims wasted work but is not configuration selection. Nothing describes choosing the cheapest configuration that still succeeds. Missing for 10: explicit cost-aware or cheapest-first strategy selection, documentation of the escalation order and cost tiers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
